## Risk and release gates

- [ ] Existing files and harnesses were extended instead of replaced.
- [ ] Provider/model compatibility was checked when applicable.
- [ ] Auth, secrets, diagnostics, uploads, metering, and local-data boundaries were reviewed.
- [ ] Windows/macOS physical checks are recorded when desktop behavior or packaging changed.
- [ ] Hosted deployment and rollback evidence are linked when deployment behavior changed.
- [ ] Any remaining planned or unverified work is stated explicitly.

Do not mark a release ready from source tests alone.
